title: typo3-upgrade-run: the skill at work
description: The upgrade as a sealed evidence graph. Recorded from real runs: the t3u harness on a scratch run and the final proof of a real TYPO3 12.4 to 14.3 update. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 47 seconds: the typo3-upgrade-run agent skill. The t3u harness seals a 72-node upgrade graph for a DDEV project and hands out the first node. The final proof of a real 12.4 to 14.3 run compares 60 URLs and 360 screenshots. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: A TYPO3 update succeeds when nobody notices. Proving that by hand is slow.
You ask for the update, with nothing visibly changed.
t3u seals a 72-node graph and hands out one node at a time.
The final proof of a real run: 360 screenshots, no undeclared difference.
A person accepts the result. Nothing deploys to live.
